steps: Start from the previously validated pre-boundary design baseline at P1 SHA 56f8f62e...: 215 visible designators and 710 pins (temperature/precharge revisions already included).
Confirm the transition 56f8f62e... to 4d274083... was a single TEXT-only correction (ID 58db56e9107cff1e); no WIRE/LINE/component/pin records changed.
Use the historical official ENET at P1 a713d448... for existing pin-net records only, as prior supporting evidence; it is not a current-source export.
Apply the current official API re-open readback for 11 new boundary objects and their 30 pin nets, then the B9 fuse-domain correction: D_BAT.2 and D_BREG.2 move from CELL_B9 to TAP_B9.
Cross-check the final direct same-EPRJ3 API object readback counts: 226 visible designators, 740 pins, and 246 TEXT records. The current-source ENET and DRC calls did not return.
